title: Sirens Song - Induction (Xtra Induction)
description: Tonight, my sweet boy, I'm going to tell you a bedtime story, of sorts... To put you into a world filled with wonder and adventure. To visualise the wonderful sights I describe. To hear the sounds which I talk about. Becoming so submerged in my tale that the world outside seems to just fade away. Wouldn't you like that? To live the story, and after have such marvelous dreams. Just picture me next to you... As I sit down, book in hand. My gaze, warm and loving upon you. Just relax for me... As I turn to the first page.
author: Mistress Shibby
